scope: Own-order retrospective analyses of fixed actual benchmark observations, plus new serial native audit timing. No embedding/detection-generation speed or population timing inference.

policies.coupled_J: Descending absolute a_L-a_R, then group identity.
policies.independent_J: Descending a_L+a_R, skip zero contribution, then group identity.
policies.coupled_C: Resolve coefficient-different H first, then descending absolute common-remainder margin coefficient; deterministic identity tie break.
policies.independent_C: Minimize worst Boolean next-response sum of individual conditional interval widths; public coefficient-equivalent groups share calculation but not labels; identity tie break. Empty defined subset has span zero only for this heuristic, never for certification.

common_preparation.scope: Parse public rows and verify emitted/reference sources, contracts and qualified reference observations. No candidate result is available to this phase.
common_preparation.compatibility_note: First block only; both separately measured preparation times are in common_preparations.

phase_definitions.common_load_register: Public registry parsing, source/contract/reference-observation hashing and row registration, performed once and reported separately.
phase_definitions.register_seconds: Per-run coefficient construction, reference-identity admission, target state and method-specific policy initialization.
phase_definitions.select_seconds: Choose the next group from public state before executing it.
phase_definitions.bounds_seconds: Compute only this method and target's current bound and stopping decision.
phase_definitions.worker_seconds: Build and validate the frozen request, launch the isolated subprocess, capture output and clean its temporary directory; includes launch overhead.
phase_definitions.receive_seconds: Parse the new stdout and admit its result into the method state.
phase_definitions.record_seconds: Serialize and write raw observations and trace records.
phase_definitions.audit_total_seconds: Wall time from per-run registration through the certified stop, including the measured phases and loop overhead.

counterbalance.design: Two complementary blocks preserve case rotation and reverse each within-case method pair. The first block is retained unchanged; the second block is bound to its exact protocol.

native_timing.accounting: Additional audit totals exclude public preparation, measured once in each of two blocks and reported separately. They include per-run coefficient/state/policy registration, query selection, requested bounds, real worker execution, admission, raw-record I/O and loop overhead. A fresh whole-audit invocation adds its preparation to either method. Medians of separate phases need not sum to the median total.
native_timing.interpretation: Six serial repeats per case and method, in two complementary blocks, describe these native executions on this recorded host. All 48 runs remain in the ranges. Public source/contract data are reused in memory within a block; candidate labels are not reused across runs, and OS caches are not claimed to be cleared. No statistical significance claim is made.

receiving.arithmetic_count_scope: Distinct histories are counted within each independently received block; a history repeated in the other block is reconstructed again.

hindsight_scope: Exact minimum number of additional unit-cost group queries for the stated joint endpoint certificate, with fixed initial admissions and all realized labels known. This is a post hoc witness diagnostic, not an executable query strategy or a claim about additional semantic inference.

nonoptimal_policy_example.meaning: The width-based shared policy does not minimize first-certificate queries on this actual finite ledger.

structural_controls: HumanEval stock/S4 and S1/S1+S4 have identical output relations; their zero-query shared certificates are structural identity controls, not independent empirical speedup cases.
